name: goldener-research
description: Local skills and plugins for the goldener-research repo.

plugins.name: sync-idea-issues
plugins.description: Sync GitHub issues labeled "idea" into the matching topic IDEAS.md file, then branch, commit, push, open a PR, and close the source issues.

plugins.name: sync-researcher-issues
plugins.description: Research GitHub issues labeled "researcher" (or researchers named directly, e.g. "add NAME to goldener research"), find relevant papers, then branch, commit, push, open a PR adding them to the matching topic RESEARCHERS.md file(s), and close any source issues.

plugins.name: sync-paper-issues
plugins.description: Research GitHub issues labeled "paper" (or papers named directly by title/link), confirm relevance, then branch, commit, push, open a PR adding them to the matching topic BIBLIOGRAPHY.md file(s), and close any source issues.

plugins.name: sync-lab-issues
plugins.description: Research GitHub issues labeled "lab" (or labs named/linked directly), resolve the lab's website and publication list, confirm which papers are relevant, and track authors reaching 3+ relevant papers as researchers, then branch, commit, push, open a PR adding papers to BIBLIOGRAPHY.md and qualifying researchers to RESEARCHERS.md, and close any source issues.
